candidate.title: Bubble-Seq
candidate.scope: The single Bubble-Seq schematic supplied by Illumina: bubble-containing DNA, restriction digestion, trapping-gel selection, plug recovery, DNA extraction, and a broad sequencing-preparation interface. The collection page heading and caption identify the same target. The Mesner et al. (2013) implementation clarifies agarose trapping and EcoRI-fragment representation; this is not a claim about every Bubble-Seq preparation. The separate introductory bubble icon is descriptive. No alternative target workflow, barcode scheme, sequencing instrument operation, or data-analysis branch is depicted.

method_scopes.rationale: All six local operations form the sole depicted Bubble-Seq route. The verified collection heading and caption agree with the assigned card. Mesner supports bubble trapping and restriction-fragment representation, and clarifies that the sequenced origin libraries had been cloned; the final schematic block remains broad. The secondary catalogue describes biotinylation, sonication, streptavidin capture and purification without drawing their placement, so those details are not expanded into new operations or another workflow. Foulk’s nascent-strand assay is background, not an alternative target. The collection also lists Mukhopadhyay et al. (2014), but no independent source for that publication is supplied here; that page-only citation is not used to assign an implementation.
